questions.question: Which friend gives the short final speech in chapter 25?
What was Bildad's main point?
options: God is unjust to the innocent
Man cannot be righteous or pure before God
The wicked always prosper in the end
questions.answer: Man cannot be righteous or pure before God

questions.question: Bildad said even the moon and stars are not pure in God's eyes.

Bildad said dominion and awe belong to God, who establishes _____ in the heights of heaven.
